name: How long does bathroom drywall installation take to complete?

mainEntity.name: How long does bathroom drywall installation take to complete?

acceptedAnswer.text: A standard bathroom drywall installation generally takes three to five days from hang to finish. Hanging the drywall boards usually takes one day, but the multi-coat taping, joint compound application, drying times, and final sanding require several consecutive days. In humid conditions or during winter months, joint compound takes longer to dry completely between coats before sanding can occur. If your bathroom remodel also includes rough-in plumbing or electrical alterations, those inspections and installations must be completely finished before hanging begins. HH Remodeling coordinates these trade rough-ins prior to drywalling so the project proceeds smoothly into finish carpentry, tile, and interior painting.
acceptedAnswer.description: Bathroom drywall installation typically takes 3 to 5 days, allowing proper drying time between multiple coats of joint compound before final sanding and paint.
